== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side), PDF page 26: the slip of [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table. During opponent's move phase, may use 3 force to peek at opponent's hand or place a Political Effect (and all cards on it) in owner's Used Pile. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not place those cards in Used Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Master List (Dark Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
